Staged 326121 (extruded profiles) is the wrong process; the FRS 336xxx set codes the customer's industry (motor vehicle parts), not the plant's process. Atlas primary follows the process: 326199. PASS 8 (2026-10-29): true legal rename — M-Tek -> Kasai North America, Inc. (Apr 2016, Kasai Kogyo's own history; CRM lineage packet C27); ultimate parent Kasai Kogyo Co., Ltd. No HQ motion: Kasai's history moves the NA head-office function to Murfreesboro TN (Aug 2016) — held for prep judgment (held_items H-8.7). HQ repair (owner ruling, pass-10 application): KASAI NORTH AMERICA, INC.'s head-office function transferred to Murfreesboro, Tennessee in Aug. 2016 per Kasai Kogyo's own corporate history (kasai.co.jp/english/corporate/history/, fetched 2026-10-29); the group's own company list places the North American head office in Murfreesboro, TN. Upper Sandusky is the Ohio manufacturing plant (SITE-001009), not the HQ. Earlier HQ attribution rested on the staged CRM row, which conflated the Ohio plant with the subsidiary's headquarters.
